user.title: Connect locally to your PureFlow15
user.description: This integration communicates directly over your local network. Fully close the Tuya Smart app before testing; the device may only accept one connection at a time.

data_description.host: Preferably reserve a fixed DHCP address for the device.
data_description.local_key: The local key is exactly 16 characters.
data_description.protocol_version: The network scan usually reports the correct 3.x version.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure PureFlow15
reconfigure.description: Update the local connection. Leave the local key empty to retain the stored key. You can then remap all datapoints as well.

mapping.title: Map the datapoints

data_description.speed_values: Comma-separated, ordered from low to high. The PureFlow15 Pro uses low, mid, high, turbo.
data_description.countdown_values: Comma-separated. The PureFlow15 Pro uses cancel, 1h, 2h, 3h, 4h, 5h.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device locally. Check its IP address, key and protocol version, and close the app.
error.power_not_boolean: The power datapoint must be a boolean (true/false).
error.speed_values_invalid: Enter at least two speed values, ordered from low to high.
error.countdown_values_invalid: Enter at least two countdown values.
error.switch_not_boolean: This datapoint must be a boolean (true/false).
error.invalid_local_key: The local key must be exactly 16 characters.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This device is already configured. Its IP address was updated.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The local connection and datapoint mappings were updated.
